decision: Use 527 data-eligible basins, subject to explicit role restrictions; no active train/val/test split created.
reason: A basin only needs adequate coverage in its assigned role. Requiring all three periods would unnecessarily exclude 18 usable basins. This uses predeclared role eligibility, without changing thresholds after the scan.
new_test_restriction: Prior pilot train/val basins and their overlap groups cannot enter final test.
clarification: summary.json usable_count=509 and usable_basins.txt are the all-periods common pool, not the final maximum role-eligible population. selected_527_basins.txt is the chosen population.
labels: Q read for QC including former pilot test, no scores/predictions produced; access logged.
implementation_remaining: Formal cache/scalers and split have not been created. Pilot preprocessing rejects partial climate references; formal builder must implement protocol.json before training.
